name: ESA WorldCover 10 m Land Cover
citation: Zanaga, D. et al. (2022), ESA WorldCover 10 m 2021 v200, Zenodo.
usedFor: Fine-grained separation of existing cropland, oil palm, mangrove, wetland and open water inside a single 250 m cell.

name: GPM IMERG Final Precipitation
instrument: GPM Core Observatory GMI + DPR, multi-satellite merged
citation: Huffman, G.J., Stocker, E.F., Bolvin, D.T., Nelkin, E.J., Tan, J. (2023), GPM IMERG Final Precipitation L3 1 day V07, Goddard Earth Sciences Data and Information Services Center.
usedFor: Higher-resolution rainfall intensity and the storm depth-duration-frequency curves used to size drainage channels and culverts.

name: GRACE-FO Terrestrial Water Storage Anomaly
program: Gravity Recovery and Climate Experiment Follow-On
usedFor: The multi-year groundwater depletion signal, which indicates whether tube-well irrigation is a durable answer or a borrowed one.

name: MODIS Evapotranspiration
citation: Running, S., Mu, Q., Zhao, M. (2021), MOD16A2 MODIS/Terra Net Evapotranspiration 8-Day L4 Global 500m SIN Grid V061, NASA EOSDIS Land Processes DAAC.
usedFor: Actual versus potential evapotranspiration, which sizes irrigation demand and farm-pond storage.

name: MODIS Land Cover Type
citation: Friedl, M., Sulla-Menashe, D. (2022), MCD12Q1 MODIS/Terra+Aqua Land Cover Type Yearly L3 Global 500m SIN Grid V061, NASA EOSDIS Land Processes DAAC.
usedFor: Masking built-up land, open water and standing forest, so the tool never recommends clearing intact forest.

name: MODIS Land Surface Temperature
citation: Wan, Z., Hook, S., Hulley, G. (2021), MOD11A2 MODIS/Terra Land Surface Temperature/Emissivity 8-Day L3 Global 1km SIN Grid V061, NASA EOSDIS Land Processes DAAC.
usedFor: Surface heat load, the cooling benefit of canopy cover, and a proxy for pond water temperature in the aquaculture model.

name: MODIS Vegetation Indices (NDVI / EVI)
citation: Didan, K. (2021), MOD13Q1 MODIS/Terra Vegetation Indices 16-Day L3 Global 250m SIN Grid V061, NASA EOSDIS Land Processes DAAC.
usedFor: Where vegetation already thrives, how green-up tracks the rains, and detection of degrading or abandoned land.

name: NASADEM Merged DEM
instrument: SRTM reprocessed with ASTER GDEM and ICESat GLAS
citation: NASA JPL (2020), NASADEM Merged DEM Global 1 arc second V001, NASA EOSDIS Land Processes DAAC.
usedFor: Preferred elevation source when an Earthdata token is configured: void-filled and more accurate than SRTMGL1 over humid tropical Borneo.

name: NASA POWER (MERRA-2 / CERES)
resolution: 0.5 deg lat x 0.625 deg lon (~55 x 69 km)
citation: NASA Langley Research Center POWER Project, CERES/MERRA-2 Native Resolution Daily Data.
usedFor: Rainfall and temperature seasonality, reference evapotranspiration, dry-spell and heat-stress statistics, rainfall return periods, and long-term trends.

name: NEX-GDDP-CMIP6 Downscaled Climate Projections
provider: NASA Earth Exchange, Ames Research Center
program: NASA Earth Exchange Global Daily Downscaled Projections
instrument: CMIP6 GCM ensemble, bias-corrected spatial disaggregation
citation: Thrasher, B., Wang, W., Michaelis, A., Melton, F., Lee, T., Nemani, R. (2022), NASA Global Daily Downscaled Projections, CMIP6, Scientific Data 9, 262.
usedFor: The years-ahead outlook. Monthly temperature and rainfall change factors per scenario and horizon are applied to the observed POWER climatology by the delta-change method, so projections inherit real local seasonality rather than a model grid-cell mean.

name: OCHA Common Operational Dataset - Administrative Boundaries
provider: UN OCHA / Department of Survey and Mapping Malaysia
citation: UN OCHA (2021), Malaysia - Subnational Administrative Boundaries, Humanitarian Data Exchange.
usedFor: The Sri Aman district boundary that defines the analysis grid.

name: OpenStreetMap
product: Standard raster tiles + Overpass vector data
usedFor: Base map tiles, plus rivers, roads and settlements used for distance-to-water and market-access context.

name: SMAP L4 Surface & Root-Zone Soil Moisture
instrument: SMAP L-band radiometer assimilated into the NASA Catchment land model
citation: Reichle, R., De Lannoy, G., Koster, R.D., Crow, W.T., Kimball, J.S., Liu, Q. (2022), SMAP L4 Global 3-hourly 9 km EASE-Grid Surface and Root Zone Soil Moisture Geophysical Data, NASA NSIDC DAAC.
usedFor: Observed wetting and drying cycles, root-zone water availability, and a reality check on the modelled soil water balance.

name: SoilGrids 250 m Soil Properties
instrument: Machine-learning prediction from roughly 240,000 soil profiles
citation: Poggio, L., de Sousa, L.M., Batjes, N.H., Heuvelink, G.B.M., Kempen, B., Ribeiro, E., Rossiter, D. (2021), SoilGrids 2.0: producing soil information for the globe with quantified spatial uncertainty, SOIL 7, 217-240.
usedFor: The local soil information half of the challenge: pH, clay/sand/silt, organic carbon, CEC, bulk density and nitrogen across six depth intervals, from which texture class, hydrologic group and drainage class are derived.

name: SRTM Global 1 arc-second Elevation
citation: NASA JPL (2013), NASA Shuttle Radar Topography Mission Global 1 arc second V003, NASA EOSDIS Land Processes DAAC.
usedFor: Slope, aspect, flow accumulation, topographic wetness index and height above nearest drainage. This is the single biggest driver of within-district contrast, and of all flood and drainage advice.
